text:
tyler: Flagging an incident during the EU aggregate recompute this morning. Backfill started ~02:00 UTC and appears to be evicting hot KV keys, causing production tail latency spikes. Proposing an operator-only soft reserve option on the backfill API so short windows can use reserved capacity.

mara: Can you paste the log snippet and the exact backfill config?

tyler: Logs (redacted):
[2026-03-20T02:07:12Z] backfill[id=bf-20260320-01] tenant=acme-eu evicting kv-key=user:pref:XXXX ttl=0
[2026-03-20T02:07:12Z] backfill[id=bf-20260320-01] eviction_count=1178 window_ms=14 tail_ms=310
[2026-03-20T02:09:03Z] production-read tenant=acme-eu tail_ms=920 error_rate=0.018

config: window=2026-03-18T00:00Z/2026-03-19T00:00Z, concurrency=24, queue=backfill-high.

kevin: If we add reserve_slots=true we must gate it to ops. Hard reserves raise cost. Instead: implement soft-reserve (min_slot_lease + weight bump) so it holds slots but allows preemption on SLO breach.

sarah: Also need billing semantics: should reserved backfills consume tenant quota or be billed to a platform bucket? We should avoid using tenant quota for operator runs.

tyler: Two more items: 1) duplicate metrics flooding observability when recomputes run, 2) console could accidentally expose override flags. I suggest operator-only flag priority_override=operator and suppress_metric_reemit=true on the job API.

mara: API sketch?

kevin: Example: POST /v1/backfills { "tenant":"acme-eu", "window":"2026-03-18T00:00Z/2026-03-19T00:00Z", "concurrency":24, "priority_override":"operator", "reserve_slots":true, "min_slot_lease":1800, "suppress_metric_reemit":true, "backfill_charge_to":"platform" }

kevin: Runtime semantics: try to lock N reserved slots (configurable per-cluster) for min_slot_lease and renew while progress>1req/s; if production SLOs slip, preempt after preempt_timeout and emit audit event.

sarah: UX: console must show a clear operator badge, require 2-step confirm for overrides, and surface billing target.

tyler: For metric duplication: don't drop metrics entirely. Annotate recompute emissions with source=backfill and expose a filter in dashboards. suppress_metric_reemit=true should avoid duplicate time-series ingestion where possible.

mara: Quota flow: backfill_charge_to=platform creates a temporary billing bucket and bypasses tenant quota checks. Need finance sign-off.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: started canary backfill bf-canary-eu-1 with reserve_slots=true, min_slot_lease=1800 on eu-staging cluster.

sarah: I'll run the canary UX + billing flow in staging, test operator 2-step, and add console breadcrumb "operator override active".

tyler: Proposed canary plan: single tenant, 2h run, reserve_slots=true, min_slot_lease=1800, suppress_metric_reemit=true. Acceptance: no production tail regression and KV evictions < 50/min. If it passes, expand to 4 tenants.

kevin: I'll open API PR + runtime guardian that enforces preempt_timeout and emits backfill.guardian.event for audits. Patch sketch: guardian = Guardian.reserve_slots(cfg.min_slot_lease); if guardian.preempted: rollback and emit audit.

mara: Add runbook entry "Operator backfill override" listing allowed scenarios, billing handling, and rollback steps.

tyler: Rollback hooks: guardian.force_release() endpoint and cancel_backfill that triggers immediate release.

kevin: Tests: ensure suppress_metric_reemit still sends critical alert signals (we only suppress duplicate telemetry events, not alert hooks).

sarah: Looping in finance for backfill_charge_to and SecOps for operator-only scope.

tyler: Thanks everyone. Expect canary update in ~30m. :eyes:
